title: Leakage Margin on Ostomy Supply Program Convex Barrier Notices
content:
A leakage share is added to the excess, as a share of it, on an Ostomy Supply Program liability notice for convex barriers (A4407) according to the no-charge replacements of the convex barrier for a product defect or transit damage shipped on the program in the last 12 months (ship date fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today).

| Such replacements in the last 12 months | Leakage margin |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 20% (the larger leakage margin) |
| Exactly one | 10% (the smaller leakage margin) |
| None | Nothing |

The leakage share is added to the order's excess per 30 days as a share of that excess.

**Cases (hypothetical, excess of 5 per 30 days, 3 blocks, so 15 before any margin).** One replacement for a product defect: 15 multiplied by 1.10 is 16.5, rounded down to 16. A defect replacement and a transit-damage replacement: 15 multiplied by 1.20 is 18. A replacement for a package lost in transit or not received does not count.
